description: Level 4 segmented and region/cell-type quantified output (optional). Includes a segmentation mask OME-TIFF and/or a region quantification table.

FILENAME.description: Name of the file. Must end with .ome.tif, .ome.tiff, or .csv

FILE_FORMAT.description: Format of the file; OME-TIFF segmentation mask or CSV quantification table

HTAN_PARENT_ID.description: HTAN Parent ID(s) - Foreign key(s) to parent entity (B for Biospecimen, D for data file). One or more IDs; for aggregated files provide multiple. Each ID must have B or D suffix. Supports HTA200-229 for phase 2.

PASSED_QC.description: Whether the file passed quality control at Level 4.

SEGMENTATION_CLASS_COUNT.description: Number of distinct tissue regions or cell types identified by the segmentation.

SEGMENTATION_METHOD.description: Algorithm or tool used for tissue or cell-type segmentation (e.g., K-means on TIC image, H&E-guided).

SEGMENTATION_REFERENCE_MODALITY.description: Modality whose segmentation output was projected onto the MSI image.
